name: Jodi Long
profileSummary: Jodi Long is an American film, stage, and television actress. She is best known for her roles as Madame Ybarra on Café Americain (1993–1994), Mrs. Kim on the Margaret Cho sitcom All-American Girl (1994-1995), Ok Cha on Sullivan & Son (2012–2014), as well as her portrayal of Wendy Yoshimura in Paul Schrader's biographical thriller film Patty Hearst (1988). She won Best Supporting Actress at the Daytime Emmy Awards for her role in the Netflix series Dash & Lily (2020).
